body.summary: v2 closes the ways around design evidence: DOEFF214 (ledgers only shrink against the base; approvals count only at the base), DOEFF212 Grew (a ledger type does not grow with evidence alone), DOEFF213 (static-key and attribute-keyed mappings, 0-or-1 sequences; answer tuples counted only). Measured on a downstream copy of 7,902 .hy files (design.md section 9.4).

scope: Design evidence (answers to the required design questions per code element): the model, where and how it is written, and doeff-linter's comparison with the shape of Hy defrecords (round 1)
